tech.summary: Duniya ki sab se bari crypto exchange Binance ke hot wallets se taqreeban $6.3 billion chori ho gaye — sirf 20 minute mein, multiple blockchains par. Binance ne $6.34 billion apne funds se side par rakh diye hain taake users ke balances poore hon, $3 billion frozen ho chuke hain, aur withdrawals filhal paused hain. Blockchain analysts ne attack ko high confidence ke saath North Korea ke hackers se jora hai.
tech.title: Binance se $6.3B ki history ki sab se bari crypto chori — exchange ne nuqsan poora karne ka wada kiya

tech.summary: US tech stocks mein Jumme ko bari girawat aayi: Intel 30% gir gaya jab us ne mana ke AI boom memory chip prices barha kar PC market ko slow kar raha hai, Amazon 5.5% gira after missing profit/revenue expectations, Nvidia 4.6% aur AMD 11.7% neeche. Nasdaq 2.7% gira. Analysts ke mutabiq market ab AI spending ki kahani nahi, us ka hisab maang rahi hai.
tech.title: Tech market bloodbath: Intel 30% crash, Amazon miss — AI trade par sawaal gehra

tech.summary: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft aur Anthropic ne 30 Oct ko elan kiya ke woh ek shared robots.txt policy token '__usage_ai-training' ko maanenge — website owners ek hi directive se chaaron labs ko AI training se rok sakenge. Anthropic ne implementation shuru kar di, Microsoft 1 Feb 2027 aur Google 2027 ko target kar raha hai. Lekin ye sirf ek draft hai, enforcement nahi, aur pehle se train ho chuka data wapas nahi hoga.
tech.title: AI labs ne pehli baar ek hi opt-out rule par ittefaq kiya — ek robots.txt line se training se inkar

tech.summary: Claude banane wali Anthropic ne 26 Oct ko SEC ke paas S-1 file kiya, Nasdaq par 'ANT' ticker ke saath list hone ka plan hai. H1 2026 revenue $16.3 billion (14x saal-ba-saal) raha, lekin net loss $80.7 billion — zyadatar non-cash convertible note revaluation. Wall Street Journal ke mutabiq valuation $1.5–2 trillion aur raise $100 billion se zyada ho sakta hai, jo SpaceX ke record ko paar kar dega.
tech.title: Anthropic ka IPO history ka sab se bara ho sakta hai — $2 trillion valuation, $100B+ raise ka target

tech.summary: DoorDash ne Instacart (Maplebear) ko taqreeban $17 billion mein acquire karne ka deal sign kiya — $65 per share, 26% premium. Ye DoorDash ka ab tak ka sab se bara acquisition hai, jis se woh restaurant delivery se aage grocery aur retail mein Walmart aur Amazon se muqabla karega. Deal 2027 ke aakhir ya 2028 ke shuru mein close hone ki umeed hai, regulatory approval sab se bara risk hai.
tech.title: DoorDash ne Instacart ko $17 billion mein khareed liya — grocery delivery ki bari jang

tech.summary: Europe ki sab se bari AI lab Mistral ne apna 1-trillion-parameter model 'Le Chonk' (Mistral Large 4) ke open weights release kar diye — organizations ise apne hardware par chala sakengi. Model coding aur cyber defense ke liye pitch kiya ja raha hai. Isi hafte Neuralink ne 'Hey Neuralink' soch kar activate hone wala Grok feature bhi dikhaya, jise ALS patient ne apni wife ko call karne ke liye use kiya.
tech.title: Mistral ka 'Le Chonk' — 1 trillion parameter open-weight model ab sab ke liye

pakistan.summary: Pakistan ki armed forces ne South Waziristan aur Parachinar se mutasil ilaqon mein Afghan Taliban ki kai posts aur military positions tabah kar di. State media ke mutabiq ye Angoor Adda mein Tuesday ko Afghan firing ka jawab tha, jis mein ek local jaan se gaya aur paanch afrad ka khandan zakhmi hua. KP Governor ne kaha Pakistan apne logon par hamle ya sovereignty ki khilaf-warzi 'kabhi bardasht nahi' karega.
pakistan.title: Pak Army ne Afghan border par Taliban posts tabah kar di — Angoor Adda firing ka jawab

pakistan.summary: Senate mein Jumme ko garm behas hui — PTI ne World Bank report ka hawala de kar kaha ke region mein poverty line se neeche rehne walon mein 48% Pakistani hain, aur detained PTI khawateen, jin mein Imran Khan ki behen Noreen Niazi shamil hain, ke ilaaj aur family access ka mutalba kiya. JUI-F ne extrajudicial killings ke Islamabad tak pohanchne par tashweesh zahir ki.
pakistan.title: Senate mein garmi: poverty, PTI khawateen ki detention aur extrajudicial killings par barbs

pakistan.summary: Sherry Rehman ki qiyadat mein PPP delegation ne doosre din bhi opposition leaders se mulaqat ki aur Parliamentary Committee on Electoral Reforms mein shirkat ki dawat di, saath hi boycott khatam kar ke standing committees mein wapas aane ka mutalba kiya. Opposition ne internal consultations ke baad jawab dene ka kaha; Ali Zafar ne kaha asal masla qanoon ki kami nahi, us par amal-daramad hai.
pakistan.title: PPP ne opposition ko electoral reforms committee mein shamil hone ki dawat di — jawab mashawarat ke baad

pakistan.summary: Market mein LPG cylinder Rs6,000–7,200 tak pohanch gaya hai jab ke Ogra ka notified price Rs3,296 hai — Iran border band aur sea imports mein kami ke baad. PM Shehbaz Sharif ne Petroleum Division ki tajweez review ke liye 8-rukni ministerial committee bana di hai, jo ek mahine mein report degi. Tajweez mein LPG imports aur price-setting Ogra se le kar state-owned enterprises ko dene ki baat hai.
pakistan.title: LPG cylinder Rs6,000–7,200 tak — PM ne policy reforms review ke liye 8-member committee bana di

pakistan.summary: PM Shehbaz Sharif ne Gilgit-Baltistan ke development projects ka jaiza lete hue 100MW solar power project ki jald takmeel ki hidayat di, saath hi Naltar Power Project, counterterrorism capacity aur digital infrastructure par bhi baat hui. GB 1 Nov ko Dogra rule se liberation aur Pakistan se accession ka din manata hai, aur PM ki us mauqe par GB visit mutawaqqa hai.
pakistan.title: PM ka GB ke liye 100MW solar project jald mukammal karne ka hukm — 1 Nov ko GB visit mutawaqqa

pakistan.summary: Pakistan aaj Lahore mein ODI tri-series final mein Sri Lanka se takrayega, pehli baar home soil par tri-series title jeetne ki umeed ke saath — aakhri baar 2008 mein jeeta tha. Pakistan ne pehle teen matches jeete (England se do, Sri Lanka se ek) lekin aakhri league match mein 110 par out ho kar 8 wickets se haara. Coach Mike Hesson ko umeed hai ke team apna best game final ke liye bacha rahi hai.
pakistan.title: Aaj Gaddafi Stadium mein final: Pakistan vs Sri Lanka — pehli home tri-series title ki talaash
